note: Our own numbers: projections, ownership and optimal rates all come from our models.
own_note: proj = mean DK points; p90 = ceiling (90th percentile of 10,000 simulated games); own = projected large-field GPP ownership %, own_se = single-entry contests %; opt = % of our simulations in which the player is in the optimal lineup; lev = opt - own; value = proj per $1,000 of salary.
